name: Brock Stoneseeker
summary: Brock Stoneseeker teaches mining in Thelsamar, in Loch Modan. At Brock's School of Mining and Surveying, he trains novice prospectors to extract ores and minerals.

sections.title: Master of Mining and Surveying
sections.body: In Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker teaches miners at Brock's School of Mining and Surveying. Loch Modan's hills hold rich mineral veins, and miners need skill with a pickaxe and an eye for the rock. Brock teaches the basics of finding ore, extracting raw metals, and surveying underground deposits. His lessons help Alliance tradesfolk supply Ironforge's smithies.

faq.answer: Brock Stoneseeker trains miners in Thelsamar, in Loch Modan. At Brock's School of Mining and Surveying, he teaches tradesfolk to extract ore and survey mineral deposits.

faq.q: Where can Brock Stoneseeker be found?
faq.answer: Brock Stoneseeker is in Thelsamar, the main dwarven town in Loch Modan. He runs his mining school near the local tradesmen.
Brock Stoneseeker teaches Mining. He shows travelers how to gather rough stone, copper, and other early ores found across the Khaz Modan countryside.

faq.q: What is Brock's School of Mining and Surveying?
faq.answer: Brock's School of Mining and Surveying is a training school in Thelsamar. Brock teaches prospectors to extract minerals safely and read underground veins throughout the mountains.

angles.text: As a miner in Loch Modan, you can find Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar to begin or advance your training in unearthing and smelting regional ores.
As a dwarf of Khaz Modan, you inherit a tradition built on stone and metal. Teachers like Brock help sustain Ironforge's craft traditions.
